title: The crystal mailroom
alt: A crystal mailroom with brass compartments, a red letter and a winding parcel conveyor.
description: A speculative mailroom built into blue crystal, from delivery tubes to a parcel conveyor.
prompt: A richly imagined futuristic mailroom built into a translucent blue crystal cavern. Curving cream-coloured delivery tubes terminate at a wall of small brass-framed compartments; one open compartment contains a neatly folded red envelope. A continuous narrow conveyor carries closed ivory parcels through the centre. Crystal facets, curved metal supports and warm task lights create elaborate depth. Coherent mechanical connections and architectural perspective, no people, no logos or legible writing.
